Based on what is already implemented, check and report what is the next step.

Based on the terminal state, M46 Phase 1 is complete and green.
What is already proven:


Runtime semantic boundary: green.


Genesis contract tests: 6 files / 10 tests passed.


Builder production build: green.


Full repository build: green.


Knowledge documentation governance check: green.

runtime-data/ and runtime/knowledge/* remain untracked operational state and must stay out of source commits.

So the immediate next step is not more implementation.
It is to commit and push M46 Phase 1 as one isolated milestone, because the phase has already satisfied its contract and validation boundary.
Use the milestone commit first, then move to M46 Phase 2.
M46 Phase 2 should be: Selection synchronization and historical navigation contract
The code added in Phase 1 has created the detail surfaces. The next step should make them behave as one historical investigation environment, not independent inspectors.
The target interaction should be:
Historical Artifact
      ↓
Evolution Episode
      ↓
Historical Relationship
      ↓
Temporal Chronology
      ↓
Knowledge / Evidence correlation
One authoritative Genesis selection should synchronize:


artifact explorer,


evolution episode inspector,


historical relationship inspector,


temporal chronology inspector,


operational projection,


replay workspace navigation.


The user should be able to move from a repository artifact to:


what happened,


what episode it belongs to,


what other evidence relates to it,


what came before/after,


what authority applied then,


whether it was superseded,


what Knowledge Operations artifact resulted,


and eventually where external conversation context will attach.


Do not start full Historical Replay execution yet.
Do not ingest conversations yet.
Do not wire Chief Agent learning yet.
The phase order should now be:


Commit/push M46 Phase 1.


M46 Phase 2 — unified Genesis selection/navigation.


M46 Phase 3 — real repository chronology correlation and Knowledge Operations lifecycle linkage.


Then bounded Historical Replay execution.


Then idempotency/recovery certification.


Then expand toward full Day-0 replay.


External conversations later enrich the same Evolution Episodes, rather than creating a separate history.


The important point is: Phase 1 has established the visual inspection contract. Phase 2 should make that contract coherent and navigable before we feed it large amounts of real Genesis history.
